app.title: Tandem
app.not_in_tauri: Tandem's UI is running outside the desktop app. Start it with `pnpm tauri dev`.
start.prompt: What do you want to work on?
start.hint: Just a name is enough. {{name}} will settle in and work alongside you.
timer.label: Time left
subtasks.title: Steps
wrap.title: That's {{n}} minutes together. Nice.
break.title: Break time
break.left: {{t}} left — stretch, sip some water, look at something far away.
chat.title: Chat
chat.empty: {{name}} is here whenever you want to talk. Try “this feels too big”.
checkin.fallback.halfway: Halfway there. I'm still here with you.
checkin.fallback.five_minutes_left: About 5 minutes left, just so you know.
checkin.fallback.two_minutes_left: Couple of minutes left. Good time to find a stopping point.
checkin.fallback.session_complete: That's the session. Nice work showing up for it. What got done?
checkin.fallback.break_over: Break's over. Want to go again, or call it here?
checkin.fallback.returned: Welcome back. Ready to pick up where you left off?
checkin.fallback.drift: Hey — want to hop back in, or switch to something else?
character.label: {{name}}, your companion, is {{state}}
character.state.waiting: waiting for you to come back
settings.title: Settings
settings.name: Companion name
settings.about_me_help: Things that help you, like “I do best with tiny first steps.” Stays on this computer unless you use a cloud provider.
settings.lan_confirm: I control this computer ({{host}}). Treat it as local.
settings.lan_help: This address is on your network. Camera images only go to providers you've confirmed you control.
settings.anthropic_key_saved: A key is saved in your system keychain.
settings.anthropic_key_placeholder: Paste a key to save it
settings.cloud_note: Messages go to Anthropic's servers. Camera images never do unless you turn on cloud vision for a session.
settings.checkin.gentle: Gentle — a short line, no reply needed
settings.status.no_tools: This model can't call tools natively; using a text fallback.
notice.reply_failed: {{name}} couldn't reply just now. Check the AI provider in Settings.
tray.toggle_buddy: Show or hide companion on desktop
buddy.label: {{name}} on your desktop. Click to open Tandem, right-click for options.
settings.buddy_help: A small always-on-top companion that never takes keyboard focus. Drag it anywhere.
settings.character_help: Who works alongside you. The name stays the same unless you change it.
character.pack.fox: Red Fox — digs a cozy den
voice.mic.off_hint: Voice is off. Turn it on in Settings → Voice.
voice.not_heard: I didn't catch that. Want to try again?
voice.error.no_mic: I can't find a microphone. Plug one in, or keep typing. That works too.
voice.error.mic_denied: Tandem doesn't have microphone access yet. You can allow it in your system's privacy settings. Typing works in the meantime.
voice.error.stt_missing: The speech model isn't downloaded yet. You can get it in Settings → Voice.
voice.error.voice_missing: {{name}}'s voice isn't downloaded yet. You can get it in Settings → Voice. Replies still show in chat.
voice.error.generic: Voice hit a snag. Typing still works.
voice.shortcut_taken: That push-to-talk shortcut is already used by another app. You can pick a different one in Settings → Voice.
settings.voice.enabled_help: The mic only listens while you hold the shortcut or press the mic button. Audio stays on this computer.
settings.voice.download_note: Speech models download from huggingface.co (and a small voice-detection model from github.com), only when you press Download. After that they run on this computer.
settings.voice.download_error: The download didn't finish: {{error}}. You can try again.
settings.voice.voice_help: Any voice works with any character. The name stays the same.
settings.voice.preview_text: Hi, I'm {{name}}. I'll be right here while you work.
settings.voice.shortcut_help: Hold it to talk from any app, let go to send. For example CommandOrControl+Shift+Space.
settings.voice.mic_meter_help: Moves while you talk. Press the mic button to test it.
settings.voice.hands_free_help: {{name}} listens for speech and replies when you pause. Audio is never saved.
settings.voice.wake_warning: Short or everyday names like “{{name}}” can trigger by accident. A two-syllable name works best, and you can rename {{name}} above.
settings.voice.barge_in: Stop talking when I start talking
settings.voice.headphones_tip: Tip: headphones work best, so {{name}} doesn't hear itself.
voice.error.mic: The microphone isn't responding. Try another one in Settings → Voice, or keep typing.
voice.error.vad_missing: Hands-free needs the voice-detection model. You can get it in Settings → Voice.
voice.error.stt_failed: I couldn't make out the recording that time. Want to try again?
voice.error.hands_free: Hands-free couldn't start. Push-to-talk and typing still work.
voice.error.tts_failed: My voice glitched for a moment. My reply is in the chat.
voice.error.no_speaker: I can't find a speaker to talk through. My replies are still in the chat.
